threat_event: E-commerce skimming captures card data entered on storefront pages or around the hosted payment fields
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 180,000 storefronts; 260 marketplace apps can add scripts; tamper-detection covers the standard checkout template only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-S1 storefronts; SYS-P4 hosted fields; cardholders of processor and gateway merchants
existing_controls: Tamper-detection on the hosted fields and standard template; marketplace listing review; WAF
treatment_plan: Script inventory and tamper-detection for all themes; marketplace script permission review and runtime monitoring; content security policy defaults

threat_event: Attacker uses a cross-division access path (the consulting identity provider or the ISV support console) to reach cardholder data in the CDE
threat_source: Cybercriminal groups using phishing and MFA code relay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-M1 uses SMS codes and is federated to SYS-G1; all 2,400 dispute analysts can bulk export case files; ISV keys visible in the support console
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-P6 dispute platform; SYS-S2 ISV console; SYS-M1
existing_controls: SYS-G1 federation; SOC monitoring of SYS-G1 sign-ins; quarterly certification of SYS-G1 users
treatment_plan: Block SMS codes for CDE access by 2026-12-31; migrate consulting users to SYS-G1 by 2027-03-31; remove bulk export; onboard SYS-P6 events to the SIEM; mask ISV keys

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses card brand, sponsor bank, FTC, state, contract, or SEC deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One matrix, never exercised; designated contacts for 2 of 4 sponsor banks; determination procedure covers only SYS-P1 to SYS-P3
affected_asset_or_process: Group incident response; bank and network notices
regulatory_driver: C-FINANCIAL-R01 (12 CFR 53.4; 225.303; 304.24); 16 CFR 314.4(j); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); Visa WTDIC
existing_controls: Group IR plan; disclosure committee charter; sponsor bank liaison team
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); record all four banks' contacts; cross-division tabletop on 2026-12-15

threat_event: AI used in payment decisions and products without adequate governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group AI Standard adopted after AI-001 and the assistant were live; no segment monitoring; assistant skipped the change gate
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-P7 fraud model; merchant insights assistant; consulting staff use of AI
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(a), 45(n)); 16 CFR 314.4(f); N51-R03 (CCPA ADMT rules, under review)
existing_controls: Model risk validation of AI-001; Group AI council
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): inventory, tiering, segment monitoring, change gate, approved tools

threat_event: Division supplement drift and undocumented inheritance hide whether Merchant Consulting controls operate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consulting supplement is the acquired firm's 2024 policy set; inheritance not documented
regulatory_driver: N54-R01 (16 CFR 314.4(f), consulting as service provider); PCI DSS 12.8.5
existing_controls: Group policies v2026; annual attestation for other divisions
treatment_plan: Re-issue the consulting supplement; inheritance matrix; attestation
owner: Merchant Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts authorization or settlement in both data centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, network, and management tools connect all divisions; both data centers share administration tooling
regulatory_driver: C-FINANCIAL-R01 (12 CFR 53.4); PCI DSS 12.10.1; N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable cross-provider backups; segmented CDE
treatment_plan: Separate administration tiers per data center; quarterly restore tests of settlement; ransomware tabletop

threat_event: Compromise of a SYS-G1 administrator gives control of identities in every division
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant keys; PAM; SOC monitoring of identity admin actions
treatment_plan: Dedicated identity administration workstations; quarterly review of identity admin roles

threat_event: Gateway or cloud region outage stops e-commerce authorizations for more than 4 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway active in one provider B region; warm standby failover untested since 2025-04
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 12.10.1; C-FINANCIAL-R01 (12 CFR 53.4, if covered services are affected)
treatment_plan: Gateway failover test by 2026-12-31; active-active design by 2027-06-30

threat_event: PAN escapes the CDE into shared services (data platform, email, tickets)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Log and email paths not covered by PAN blocking; dispute evidence by email
existing_controls: Weekly PAN discovery; ingestion PAN block (extended 2026-06)
treatment_plan: PAN block on all log sources (done); evidence portal replaces email; consulting mailbox purge

threat_event: 2026 ROC produces a non-compliant AOC and sponsor banks demand remediation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consulting access, scope inventory, and contacts gaps open into the ROC window
affected_asset_or_process: Sponsor bank relationships; card brand registration
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 12.4.1; 12.5.2.1; C-FINANCIAL-R02 (sponsor banks' III.D oversight)
treatment_plan: Close High POA&M items before 2026-11-02 or document compensating controls with the QSA

threat_event: Software supply chain compromise of a build pipeline pushes malicious code into a CDE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two divisions run separate pipelines with different controls
treatment_plan: Common pipeline security standard; build provenance checks

threat_event: HSM key compromise or ceremony failure exposes vault encryption keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual control depends on custodians in two sites
existing_controls: Dual control; split knowledge; HSM tamper response
treatment_plan: Annual ceremony audit by internal audit

threat_event: Materiality decision for a cyber incident is late or inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee has never decided a cross-division incident
treatment_plan: Include a materiality decision in the 2026-12-15 tabletop

threat_event: Covered data transaction gives a country of concern access to bulk financial data through a vendor or employee
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor screening covers sanctions, not 28 CFR 202 covered persons
existing_controls: Sanctions screening; no offshore access to CDE
treatment_plan: Add 28 CFR 202 covered-person screening to vendor onboarding

threat_event: Hurricane closes Florida operations centers and stresses data center 1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary data center and two operations centers in Florida
affected_asset_or_process: Data center 1; settlement and support staff
existing_controls: Active-active second data center out of state; remote work
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low with the second data center and remote work

threat_event: Fraud model drift causes mass false declines across merchants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-free in-house model; drift alerts exist but decline-rate alerts by segment do not
owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud

threat_event: Workforce generative AI use leaks client, merchant, or cardholder data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consulting staff use public chatbots; group approved-tools list not yet applied to SYS-M1 users
existing_controls: Enterprise assistant approved for SYS-G1 users
treatment_plan: Block public chatbots for consulting devices; approved tool for consulting

threat_event: Sponsor bank exits after a compliance or notice failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Four banks with different regulators; each relies on the division's notices and AOC
treatment_plan: Annual bank due diligence package with AOC, SOC 1, SOC 2 readiness, and P07 results
owner: Head of bank and network relationships
